wings.name: Miyamoto Musashi
wings.title: The Master
wings.hook: Swordsman, painter and writer of The Book of Five Rings.

wings.name: Marcus Aurelius
wings.title: The Steady Mind
wings.hook: The Roman emperor whose private notes became Meditations.

wings.name: Nikola Tesla
wings.title: The Inventor
wings.hook: The inventor known for his work on alternating current.

wings.name: Cleopatra VII
wings.title: The Scholar Queen
wings.hook: The last Ptolemaic ruler of Egypt, who spoke many languages and ruled for 21 years.

wings.name: Leonardo da Vinci
wings.title: The Curious Mind
wings.hook: The painter of the Mona Lisa who filled thousands of notebook pages with questions.

wings.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj
wings.title: The Founder King
wings.hook: Founder of the Maratha state, builder of hill forts and a navy, crowned in 1674.

wings.name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie
wings.title: The Radium Pioneer
wings.hook: The scientist who discovered polonium and radium and won two Nobel Prizes.

wings.name: William Shakespeare
wings.title: The Playwright
wings.hook: The actor and part-owner of a theatre who wrote about 39 plays and 154 sonnets.

wings.name: Saladin
wings.title: The Just Sultan
wings.hook: The sultan who united Egypt and Syria, retook Jerusalem and made peace with Richard.

wings.name: Isaac Newton
wings.title: The Natural Philosopher
wings.hook: The farm boy who explained light, motion and gravity with experiments and maths.

wings.name: Benjamin Franklin
wings.title: The Self-Made Citizen
wings.hook: Printer, scientist and statesman who gave his inventions away.

wings.name: Katsushika Hokusai
wings.title: The Restless Painter
wings.hook: The Edo artist who drew all his life and said he was still learning.

wings.name: Abraham Lincoln
wings.title: The Self-Taught President
wings.hook: With under a year of school, he taught himself law and wrote words that held a nation.

wings.name: Vincent van Gogh
wings.title: The Colour Seeker
wings.hook: He began painting at 27 with no training and found a new language of colour.

wings.name: Galileo Galilei
wings.title: The Observer
wings.hook: He built a better telescope, looked up, and let what he saw settle old arguments.

wings.name: Charles Darwin
wings.title: The Patient Naturalist
wings.hook: He sailed round the world collecting facts, then spent 20 years testing one big idea.

wings.name: Ludwig van Beethoven
wings.title: The Unbroken Composer
wings.hook: The composer who lost his hearing and wrote his greatest music anyway.

wings.name: Mahatma Gandhi
wings.title: The Peaceful Rebel
wings.hook: He turned peaceful refusal into a method millions could use, from Durban to Dandi.

wings.name: Thomas Alva Edison
wings.title: The Invention Factory
wings.hook: He built a lab to invent on purpose: the phonograph, electric light and much more.

wings.name: Jane Austen
wings.title: The Close Observer
wings.hook: She wrote in a busy sitting room, signed her books "By a Lady", and changed the novel.

wings.name: Mansa Musa
wings.title: The Pilgrim King
wings.hook: The emperor of Mali whose 1324 pilgrimage put West Africa on the world's maps.

wings.name: Queen Victoria
wings.title: The Long Reign
wings.hook: Queen for 63 years, who wrote down her days in 122 volumes of journals.

wings.name: Jalal al-Din Rumi
wings.title: The Reed's Song
wings.hook: A Konya teacher whose friendship and grief became the Divan and the Masnavi.

wings.name: Elizabeth I
wings.title: The Learned Queen
wings.hook: The scholar queen who ruled England for 44 years through danger and war.

wings.name: Ada Lovelace
wings.title: The Visionary
wings.hook: Her 1843 Notes saw that a calculating machine could work with more than numbers.

wings.name: Harriet Tubman
wings.title: The Conductor
wings.hook: She escaped slavery, then went back again and again to guide others to freedom.

wings.name: Frederick Douglass
wings.title: The Free Voice
wings.hook: He taught himself to read, escaped slavery and became a great speaker and editor.

wings.name: Confucius
wings.title: The Teacher
wings.hook: The teacher whose sayings, collected as the Analects, shaped China for 2,000 years.

wings.name: Mark Twain
wings.title: The Storyteller
wings.hook: River pilot turned writer who lost a fortune, then paid back every debt.

wings.name: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)
wings.title: The Physician Philosopher
wings.hook: Physician and philosopher who wrote The Canon of Medicine.

wings.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky
wings.title: The Deep Heart
wings.hook: Faced a firing squad, survived Siberia, and wrote Crime and Punishment.

wings.name: Ibn Battuta
wings.title: The Traveller
wings.hook: The Moroccan judge who travelled for 29 years and dictated the Rihla.

wings.name: Aristotle
wings.title: The First Teacher
wings.hook: Plato's student, Alexander's tutor, and a founder of logic and biology.

wings.name: Socrates
wings.title: The Questioner
wings.hook: He wrote nothing, questioned everyone, and would not stop to save his life.

wings.name: Plato
wings.title: The Teacher
wings.hook: The Athenian thinker who founded the Academy and wrote the Republic.

wings.name: Alexander Graham Bell
wings.title: The Voice Carrier
wings.hook: A teacher of deaf students who learned how to send the human voice down a wire.

wings.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
wings.title: The Traveling Prodigy
wings.hook: He toured Europe from age six and wrote music that pleases experts and beginners alike.

wings.name: Michelangelo Buonarroti
wings.title: The Tireless Sculptor
wings.hook: The sculptor who painted a ceiling he called "not my trade" and carved until 88.

wings.name: Ashoka the Great
wings.title: The Emperor of Dhamma
wings.hook: After one terrible war, he carved regret and kindness into rocks across India.

wings.name: Rabindranath Tagore
wings.title: The Poet-Teacher
wings.hook: Poet, songwriter, painter and teacher who built a school under the trees.

wings.name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
wings.title: The Self-Taught Mathematician
wings.hook: A Madras clerk whose notebooks of formulas still surprise mathematicians today.
